description: DONE (folded 2026-07-03, single-lane audited PASS — test-only). Added 7 direct unit tests for fixture_facts::drop_closure_capture_tag (the bracket-balanced stripper that swallows the closure[...] display tag from call-edge snapshots), which previously had ONLY indirect golden-fixture coverage. Tests (all mutation-verified to bite exactly): non-tag-untouched, partial-prefix-untouched (closureXYZ[...]), flat-capture-strip, nested-bracket-balance (bites via an independent find(']') naive-strip comparison — proven not a tautology), adjacent-unrelated-list-untouched, unbalanced-input-consumes-to-end (pinned+documented as unreachable — format_closure_lit_suffix always emits balanced brackets, audit-verified), and a happy-path via stable_type_text (integration on the real #<id>closure[...] shape). Chose (a) pin-and-document the unbalanced edge over adding untested backoff for a dead path. drop_closure_capture_tag stayed private (no visibility widened); golden fixtures unchanged; 1193/0/9. Minor observation (non-blocking, no ticket): no test asserts format_closure_lit_suffix's always-balances invariant itself — worth a note if anyone touches that function.
title: Direct unit test for fixture_facts drop_closure_capture_tag (currently only golden-fixture coverage)
